messages:
jamie: Quick question — planning an 8-week snowbird to FL over winter (Nov 15 -> Jan 10). Do I need to officially declare a temporary homebase change? wondering about WFH stipend proration, payroll withholding, and laptop shipping. :beach_with_umbrella:
leah (People Ops): Yes please declare — anything >30 days needs the temporary homebase form so we can track payroll/tax nexus & benefits. Link: https://hr.redwood.example/homebase-declare :paperclip:
jamie: Thanks — does declaring trigger a permanent homebase switch or just a temporary flag?
leah (People Ops): Temporary only — we mark the end date on the form. It does not change your HQ for benefits enrollment. Will also notify Payroll & our tax vendor.
tyler (Eng): FYI from infra — if you want laptop shipped to FL, request through the equipment ticketing flow. Shipping is covered up to $60 for temporary moves; anything above needs manager pre-approval.
jamie: How is the WFH stipend handled — fully paid for that month or prorated?
omar (Finance): Stipend is prorated by days in the month. Example: $200/month -> 30 days -> if you're there 16 days you get (16/30)*200. We can provide the exact calc after form submission.
leah (People Ops): Also note state tax: moving to FL temporarily likely doesn't create FL withholding (FL no income tax) but it can impact your state nexus in your resident state. We're not tax advisors — our payroll/tax vendor reviews each case and will flag if a filing is needed.
jamie: Sounds good. Any cutoffs for benefits or worker comp?
leah (People Ops): No benefits change. Worker comp remains with your permanent homebase unless you go >182 days in another state — then we escalate. For 8 weeks you're fine.
jamie: Great. I filled the form. hr-bot: "homebase-declare" form submitted by jamie at 1727777777. Next steps: People Ops review -> Payroll notified -> Equipment ticket if shipping requested.
leah (People Ops): Got it, Jamie. I'll review and loop in payroll. Can you @tyler in the equipment ticket if you want the laptop rerouted?
jamie: Done — ticket #EQ-4532 created, asked for shipping to FL address and noted travel dates.
tyler (Eng): Saw EQ-4532. I approved the shipping allowance. Please attach ID and shipping address to the ticket.
omar (Finance): Jamie, once Payroll receives the declare form we'll update withholding flags for the period and confirm stipend proration on your next paycheck. Expect confirmation within 5 business days.
jamie: Awesome — thanks all. One last Q: do I need manager signoff?
leah (People Ops): Manager acknowledgment is required for equipment and any long-term (>90d) homebase changes. For this 8-week snowbird, manager ack is optional but helpful — please cc your manager on the form.
jamie: cc'd my manager. thanks :thumbsup:
leah (People Ops): You're all set from POps side. Payroll will post an update here when done.
hr-bot: Payroll notified (ticket PR-9981). Estimated action by 1727777812.
